task: Add a git pre-commit hook in /opt/webapp that runs flake8 on staged Python files.
raw:
```bash
mkdir -p /opt/webapp/.git/hooks
echo '#!/bin/bash
files=$(git diff --cached --name-only | grep '\.py$')
if [ -n "$files" ]; then
  flake8 $files
  if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "flake8 passed"
  else
    echo "flake8 failed"
    exit 1
  fi
fi' > /opt/webapp/.git/hooks/pre-commit
